data.title: What Is Data-Driven Design? Moving Beyond Intuition in 2026
data.html_title: What Is Data-Driven Design? Definition, Process & Examples
data.html_description: Move beyond intuition. Learn what data-driven design is, how to combine qualitative and quantitative insights, and see real-world examples of successful implementation.
data.description: "I think users will like this color." "I believe this layout feels more intuitive." These statements represent the old guard of design decision-making - a world governed by gut feelings and personal preferences. But in 2026, successful design teams have moved beyond the "I think" era into the "I know" paradigm.
